_comment: Class names a stylesheet can apply OUTSIDE its own shell — i.e. defined in a selector whose first compound is not a shell root (.mdx-shell/.pdev-shell/.c2c-v2/.qms-shell). Vite appends each shell CSS chunk to <head> and never removes it, so two unscoped definitions both go live once a user visits two shells in a session and the later one wins. This list may only SHRINK.
_note: Was 284 before mdx/*.css was scoped under .mdx-shell. The remainder are v2 utility classes that are not prefixed with .c2c-v2, several of them in orphaned stylesheets.
